scope.reason: Validate individual attachment and muscle mechanics in isolation before any A2-A6 homology or full-body actuation.

used_for: DL DO VL VO VA T spatial groups

body_fixed_coordinate_system.theta: radians around the cross-section; 0 dorsal, -pi/2 left lateral, -pi ventral
body_fixed_coordinate_system.d: fractional depth inward from the schematic shell
body_fixed_coordinate_system.note: Cross-section ratios and depth are diagnostic geometry, not measured L1 dimensions.

attachment_hypothesis.derivation: Preserve published spatial-group order and orientation; assign deterministic lanes within each group without digitizing any source image.

isolated_mechanics.coordinate: one independent shortening coordinate q per fiber
isolated_mechanics.calibration_objective: zero-input equilibrium plus bounded non-oscillatory diagnostic response within 0.5 s; not fitted to biological force
isolated_mechanics.uncertainty: No biological force, mass, stiffness, damping, or individual attachment coordinate is inferred from these model-unit values.

limitations: The straight origin-to-insertion chord is a schematic line of action, not a traced fiber volume.
Direct versus indirect tendon topology is not assigned per individual muscle.
Internal, median, and external layer identity remains unresolved per fiber.
Fibers have independent generalized coordinates and do not yet share a deformable cuticle or pressure field.
The fixture cannot move, yaw, pitch, or translate the full body.
